title.zh: 合成器安全与呈现链路推进

summary.en: This week's work advanced the compositor toward a safer, more direct presentation path: shared GPU mailbox transport, owned window surfaces, and Linux sandboxing all moved forward together.
summary.zh: 本周的工作围绕更安全、更直接的合成器呈现路径推进：共享 GPU mailbox 传输、独占窗口呈现 surface 与 Linux 沙箱同步落地。

en: Added GPU mailbox fencing and mmap-based zero-copy transport.
Added an owned window presentation surface for the compositor.
Added Linux seccomp and Landlock sandboxing for compositor isolation.
zh: 补齐 GPU mailbox fence 与基于 mmap 的零拷贝传输。
为合成器加入独占窗口呈现 surface。
为合成器隔离加入 Linux seccomp 与 Landlock 沙箱。

inProgress.en: Browser product integration, rendering compatibility, and complete DOM/Web API coverage continue as active work.
inProgress.zh: 浏览器产品整合、渲染兼容性，以及完整 DOM/Web API 覆盖仍在持续推进。
